narration: You saved for years, got the keys, and felt incredible. Then month two hit — and nobody warned you about the other twenty-three thousand dollars that comes with owning a home.
visual: House SVG with keys on dark background. Bills labeled 'Repair Bill,' 'Property Tax,' 'Insurance' float in around the house. Big amber $23,400 text appears.

narration: Number one: maintenance. Financial experts say budget one percent of your home's value every single year. On a $350,000 house, that's $3,500 — and that's the floor, not the ceiling.
visual: House SVG on light background. Repair icons spring in — water drop for roof leak, HVAC unit, plumbing pipes. Counter animates up to $3,500/yr.

narration: Number two: property taxes and insurance. Both go up every single year. The average American pays thirty-seven-eighty-five in property taxes — and home insurance jumped twenty-one percent in just two years.
visual: Dark background. Tax bill document and insurance shield SVGs spring in side by side with dollar amounts. '+21%' badge animates in at the bottom.

narration: Number three: utilities, HOA fees, and your appliances all have expiration dates. A fridge, washer, water heater, HVAC — add it up and you're looking at five to eight thousand dollars a year, minimum.
visual: Light background. Fridge, washer, water heater, HVAC icons spring in one by one. '$5K–$8K/YR in hidden costs' callout box appears.

narration: Add it all up and the average homeowner spends twenty-three thousand four hundred dollars a year beyond their mortgage. Over thirty years, that's seven hundred thousand dollars that never shows up in any rent-versus-buy calculator.
visual: Dark background. Line items appear one by one — maintenance, taxes, insurance, utilities. Running counter animates up to $23,400. Red '$700,000 over 30 years' badge springs in.

narration: Before you buy, run the real numbers. Add the one percent rule, your taxes, insurance, and utilities to your mortgage payment. That's your actual housing cost — and for most people, it changes everything.
visual: Light background. Checklist with four items ticking in — maintenance, property taxes, home insurance, utilities. Final callout box: 'Add $1,950/month — THAT'S YOUR REAL COST.'
